description.value:
Cost: 1,000eb (Very Expensive) ♦ Install: Clinic

Humanity Loss: 7 (2d6)

An upgrade to random-access memory for superior processing speed.

Neuralware. Requires Neuroport Cyberdeck Port. The user may activate this cyberware without an Action to enable attempting one additional Quickhack per target in that Turn. This still requires spending the Net Action to Perform a Quickhack, and cannot be used to attempt the same Quickhack twice on one Target in a Turn. This cyberware has a 30 second (10 Rounds) cooldown before it can be activated again.

This cyberware can be installed multiple times, up to a maximum of three installations. Each installation increases the amount of possible Quickhack attempts per target independently (e.g., two active RAM Upgrades allows attempting up to three different Quickhacks per target in that Turn).

Type: Neuralware
Install: Clinic
Option Slots: uses 1

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Cyberware > Neuralware).
